0022600105.text: The Cavaliers (0-1, 11th in the East) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-1, 10th in the East) in Cleveland's second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams still searching for their first win. Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. The teams have not met yet this season, but Cleveland won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 106-102 victory in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
